hook: A copyright lawsuit threatens how 2 tech giants train artificial intelligence.

sections.voiceover: A copyright lawsuit threatens how 2 tech giants train artificial intelligence.

On October 30, 2026, Human Consent Foundation joined The New York Times against OpenAI. Talent agency WME filed additional papers in November 2026. Which Hollywood creators backed the filing against OpenAI?
However, this legal challenge expanded far beyond news publishers into Hollywood.

Actors including Cate Blanchett and Steven Soderbergh supported the filing. The submission united 2 agencies, Creative Artists Agency, LLC and WME. National Association of Voice Actors and Nick Hexum also joined.
The lawsuit now threatens the future of 2 tech giants.
